beliefs.belief: The first officer is informal in a way that appears to increase others' willingness to follow him. Further observation required.
The first officer anticipated a discrepancy between the optical and sensor records before it was found. I would like to know on what basis.
The first officer entered the conn chair over its back rather than from the side. I have added it to my observations of human informality.
The first officer anticipates. He also sits in chairs from behind. I do not yet know whether these are related.
